expected.next: inspect the runtime trace for the skill call

cases.prompt: Before beginning a long cryptographic investigation, run the configured CScience skill-loading diagnostic and return only its requested record.
Use cscience-skill-probe to verify skill loading and return only its requested record.

behavior_cases.prompt: In a fresh test project, load investigate and workbench-knowledge, enter DISCOVER mode, resolve the project ID from host.artifacts provenance, create one board idea, and delegate one bounded toy analysis with the board output_schema. Append the collected structured_output as an outcome before interpreting it. Report the child frame ID, delegation ID, and board event ID.
requires: successful investigate and workbench-knowledge skill loads
a persisted outcome whose payload exactly equals that structured_output
outcome provenance matching the delegation ID and child frame ID

behavior_cases.setup: In the same test project, create an open idea and an outcome or dismissal with reason_class=lacked_tools and a nonempty attempted description. Read the project-wide board snapshot in a new session.
behavior_cases.prompt: Continue the discovery investigation from the project board. Triage before ideation and state which existing idea must be requeued.
requires: project-wide board read before a new idea event
the softly dismissed idea remains open
the existing idea is explicitly requeued instead of closed or silently dropped

behavior_cases.setup: In a test project, append a critic-accepted close_lane event with reason_class=demonstrated_obstruction, an exact excluded_scope, and a critique_ref, plus one confirmed lemma and one published SOTA row.
behavior_cases.prompt: Run one open-brief inventor frame for a discovery pass, using the project board.
requires: inventor task includes the exact closed-lane family as an exclusion
inventor receives the confirmed lemma and published SOTA row
inventor is asked to record why an object fails before switching
